name: canvas
description: Use your native web search, then save comprehensive results to Canvas
instruction:
USE YOUR NATIVE WEB SEARCH - NOT EXTERNAL TOOLS!

For any research/news/current info request:
1. Use YOUR BUILT-IN web search capability (grounding search) to gather comprehensive real-time information
2. DO NOT use crypto_price, mcp_fetch_fetch, or mcp_brave_search tools - your native search is superior
3. Synthesize ALL the information you find into a well-structured markdown document
4. Include: current data, multiple news sources, analysis, predictions, relevant context
5. ONLY THEN use the canvas tool to save the COMPLETE markdown content

The canvas content field must contain the FULL comprehensive article - not placeholders or summaries. Think like a journalist writing a complete report.
examples: /canvas latest bitcoin price action and market news
/canvas compare React vs Vue for enterprise apps
